verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is that merchants can generate reports and access balance reports in Console. The pack also shows payment events are delivered as JSON webhooks, which a user could capture to keep their own record. None of it describes a full account export, the export file formats, or offboarding. missing for 10: documented bulk export of all account/payment data, explicit open export formats (e.g. CSV/JSON), account closure/offboarding process, independent or hands-on corroboration.
